subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should ordinary primary-agent browser tabs become ephemeral at task completion by default, and which ownership signals must preserve a tab?
rationale: The code can already close exact session-owned tabs, but choosing a default task-completion cleanup policy changes browser ownership semantics and could close pages users expected to keep.

options.title: Adopt ownership-based cleanup
options.body: Close tabs created by the current primary-agent run after completion while preserving explicitly user-owned or keep-open tabs.

options.title: Keep idle/cap cleanup only
options.body: Leave current shipped behavior unchanged and rely on background cleanup plus manual close/reset paths.

options.title: Make task cleanup opt-in
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in mode after defining upgrade-safe config and documentation.

recommendation.title: Adopt ownership-based cleanup
recommendation.body: Close tabs created by the current primary-agent run after completion while preserving explicitly user-owned or keep-open tabs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete most recently carried the overlapping reset cleanup through a merged PR and is the best routed owner for the browser ownership product choice.
